messages:
Hannah: Heads-up: p99 climbed ~50% for /v1/generate on the endpoint-percentiles panel around 04:05 UTC. p50/p95 look flat. Anyone seen a tail-only blip?
Luca: Which filters? region, model, timeframe?
Hannah: Console -> Latency -> Endpoints. Filters: region=eu-west, model=redwood-13b, window=5m centered 04:00-04:10. Link: https://console/redwood/latency?endpoint=/v1/generate
Priya: Quick glance at routing: we rolled routing-policy v3.1 at 03:57 that adjusted weights to favor burst-capacity. That may have nudged some traffic to pool:burst-cold.
Nina: Telemetry shows a handful of fallback decisions 04:04-04:07 with reason=quota_spike for tenant=edu-labs. Log sample: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-04T04:04:35Z","tenant":"edu-labs","route":"api-generate","decision":"fallback","target":"pool:burst-cold","reason":"quota_spike"}
```
Luca: Are percentiles in the UI from merged t-digests or naive per-origin aggregation? Important for tail attribution.
Priya: Backend aggregates t-digests across shards (correct) but the endpoint rollup view intentionally hides sample_origin counts to reduce clutter. That makes tails look like a platform regression when actually it's origin-specific.
Hannah: So math is right, presentation is the problem. We need to expose origin-side contribution in the rollup UI.
Nina: Also, sampling rates differ by proxy. If burst-cold had higher sampling for a short window, the p99 could be biased. We should show sample_count and dominant origins.
Luca: Proposal: 1) Immediate: add a compact badge next to percentiles showing total_sample_count and a small chevrons menu listing top-2 origins with percentages. 2) Short-term: make a one-click partition that re-runs the percentiles grouped by sample_origin. 3) Medium: surface sampling_fraction metadata in the Console API for audit.
Priya: I can add the badge + drill link; ETA today afternoon. Also suggest a low-sample warning when sample_count < 75.
Hannah: Can we also tweak the alerting rule? We have an automated p99 alert on endpoints; it currently triggers on absolute p99 delta. For rollups, we should gate alerts when sample_count < X or when a single origin contributes < 10% of traffic to avoid noise.
Luca: Agreed. I'll add a suppression rule for alerts when top_origin_percent < 20% and sample_count < 100. We'll iterate.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-service v1.8 deployed at 2026-03-04T03:55:12Z (sha: d4e5f6a) :gear:
Nina: Action items: Priya PR for badge+drill (PR link in thread), Luca to update alert suppression config, Hannah to notify CS if any customers report regressions.
Hannah: Thanks all. Once PR is live, we'll re-evaluate p99 trend and decide whether to roll routing tweak back. :thumbsup:
